Nina (People Ops): @here Quick policy bulletin  two small updates + a required Code of Conduct reminder. Please skim TL;DR then read the links if affected.

Nina (People Ops): 1) Jury duty paid leave increase (pilot)
- Effective: July 1
- What: Paid jury duty increased from 5 days to 10 days (US & Canada pilot). Additional unpaid time or comp-time available after 10 days per manager approval.
- How to notify: Submit copy of summons via HR portal -> Time Off -> Jury Duty and choose "Paid Jury Pilot".

Nina (People Ops): 2) Emergency disaster leave (new)
- What: Up to 5 paid days per calendar year for employees directly affected by natural disasters (fires, floods, earthquakes) preventing work.
- Eligibility: Documented impact required (utility outage, evacuation notice, etc.). Managers can approve additional comp-time for coverage.
- Filing: Use HR portal -> Emergency Leave -> Attach proof. Payroll processes any pay adjustments next cycle.

hr-bot: Policies updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/jury-emergency-2027 (version 2027-07-01)

Legal Team: Reminder  policy respects local law where it provides longer leave; local entitlements supersede pilot where applicable.

Sam R.: Quick Q  if I already used 6 jury days this year, do I get extra paid days under the pilot?

Nina (People Ops): Yes for jury service starting on/after July 1. For ongoing service that began before July 1 well review case-by-case; DM me and HR will assist.

Oliver G.: For Emergency Leave, if my home is not damaged but my commute is disrupted (road closures), does that qualify?

Nina (People Ops): Yes, documented evacuation orders or official road closure/utility outage that prevents safe commute qualifies. The portal has a checklist of acceptable documentation.

Nina (People Ops): Code of Conduct reminder  all staff must complete the 8-min refresher course by July 15. Link + auto-enroll in LMS: https://lms.redwood.internal/coc-2027. Managers will receive compliance reports.

hr-bot: Completion status updated nightly. Non-compliance will trigger manager reminders after July 16.

Sam R.: Thanks, putting the jury summons in the portal now.

Nina (People Ops): Office hours Wednesday 23pm PT in #people-ops-office-hours for questions and help uploading docs. Thanks everyone! :handshake:
